cluster.description: Cluster name, exactly as returned by list_clusters.

format.description: Output encoding. table is the cheapest for this tool. format "json" is refused here because the raw payload carries scrape URLs, which routinely embed credentials.

health.description: Filter by scrape health. Use "down" to go straight to what is broken.

job.description: Restrict to one scrape job, matched exactly against the job label.

limit.description: Maximum targets to return. The summary counts every target regardless of this limit.
